note: The session's web search allowance ran out partway through (after about the first fifteen candidates were searched), so the legislative candidates were looked up through the Montana Democratic Party's candidates page, county party pages, Wikipedia's election pages and the campaign sites they link. The Democratic party's candidates page lists its nominees with links and does not say 'endorsed', so it gives websites only, no endorsed_by. The Montana Republican Party's honor roll and the county parties' slate cards and voter guides are support, not endorsements (see ballot/lean/mt_endorsements.json), and are not recorded here. Sitting legislators (Gillespie, Powers, Schomer, Ellis, Rosenzweig) were checked for a website only. Deputy county attorney and similar staff posts were treated as jobs, not offices. Blank means not found, not that nothing exists.
